unit_attributes.statement: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When there are material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity.
unit_attributes.statement: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

unit_attributes.scope_text: When there are material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity, except for married names as provided in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).
unit_attributes.choice_text: One or more of the following: (1) Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders, or (b) Divorce decrees; (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
unit_attributes.statement: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more acceptable documents (court orders or decrees such as name change orders or divorce decrees; certificates of naturalization; marriage certificates; documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or documentation of customary usage), except for married names under 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).

unit_attributes.scope_text: When evidence of material name changes is submitted.
unit_attributes.statement: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1).

unit_attributes.scope_text: After a material name change, unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.
unit_attributes.statement: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).

unit_attributes.scope_text: Under 22 CFR 51.23(c), in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant.
unit_attributes.statement: Because the applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity, evidence of identity might be required under 22 CFR 51.23(c) in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant.

unit_attributes.scope_text: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change.
unit_attributes.statement: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

unit_attributes.scope_text: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, and there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel.
unit_attributes.statement: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, and there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name.
The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Prior to returning the name change documentation to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL).
unit_attributes.statement: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL).

unit_attributes.scope_text: For applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11.
unit_attributes.statement: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11, if the ID has not yet been changed.
unit_attributes.statement: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 must submit their name change documentation if their ID has not yet been changed.
